title: Comparison of autogenous and allograft bone rings in surgically created vertical bone defects around implants in a sheep model
authors: Benlidayi ME, Salimov F, Tukel HC, Yüksel O. 2018. Clin Oral Implants Res. [Epub ahead of print].
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Allograft bone ring looks promising in augmentation of surgically created vertical bone defects around implants after 8 months of healing” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
